display.purpose: Page titles only, one per view.

label.purpose: Field labels, tab text, chips, badges.

mono.purpose: Identifiers, coordinates, raw values, code — read character by character, not compared as quantities.

shadows.name: ambient-low
shadows.purpose: The lightest separation, for a control that detaches slightly from its row. Rare.

shadows.name: floating
shadows.purpose: Dialogs and toasts — the only elements unambiguously above the page plane.

shadows.name: inset-ring
shadows.purpose: Status chips keep their exact outer dimensions when state changes colour.

shadows.name: contrast-ring
shadows.purpose: High-contrast theme replaces every soft shadow with a hard ring.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: The only easing curve in the system. Fast-out, settled-in.

motion.name: dur-fast
motion.purpose: Colour and background state changes on controls.

motion.name: dur-normal
motion.purpose: Rail tab colour and border transitions.

motion.name: dur-slow
motion.purpose: The longest transition the system permits.

breakpoints.name: shell
breakpoints.note: Below this the fixed app shell releases its height and the page becomes the scroller.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: One per view. The committed action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.25rem; padding: 0.35rem 0.7rem; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; background: var(--brand, oklch(70% 0.16 205)); color: var(--on-brand, oklch(14% 0.02 205)); border: 1px solid var(--brand, oklch(70% 0.16 205)); border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--brand-hover, oklch(74% 0.16 205)); border-color: var(--brand-hover, oklch(74% 0.16 205)); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: var(--bg-elevated, oklch(19% 0.02 260)); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring, oklch(85% 0.14 205)); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A visible boundary with no fill. The default for every action that is not the committed one.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.25rem; padding: 0.35rem 0.7rem; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; background: transparent; color: var(--ink-muted, oklch(75% 0.02 260)); border: 1px solid var(--stroke-strong, oklch(40% 0.015 260)); border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--surface, oklch(22% 0.02 260)); color: var(--ink, oklch(96% 0.005 260)); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring, oklch(85% 0.14 205)); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 3px; }

components.name: Default Button
components.description: The resting button: a surface ground and a visible hairline.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.25rem; padding: 0.35rem 0.7rem; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; background: var(--surface, oklch(22% 0.02 260)); color: var(--ink, oklch(96% 0.005 260)); border: 1px solid var(--stroke-strong, oklch(40% 0.015 260)); border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn:hover { background: var(--surface-hover, oklch(26% 0.02 260)); } .ds-btn:active { background: var(--bg-elevated, oklch(19% 0.02 260)); } .ds-btn:disabled { opacity: 0.38; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring, oklch(85% 0.14 205)); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 3px; }

components.name: Outcome Button
components.description: The dispatch controls. Deliberately not solid — a button that shouts is a button pressed by accident.
components.css: .ds-btn-approve, .ds-btn-reject { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0.35rem 0.7rem; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; background: transparent; border-width: 1px; border-style: solid; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-approve { color: var(--ok, oklch(72% 0.16 155)); border-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ok, oklch(72% 0.16 155)) 35%, transparent); } .ds-btn-approve:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ok, oklch(72% 0.16 155)) 10%, transparent); } .ds-btn-reject { color: var(--danger, oklch(65% 0.22 25)); border-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--danger, oklch(65% 0.22 25)) 35%, transparent); } .ds-btn-reject:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--danger, oklch(65% 0.22 25)) 10%, transparent); } .ds-btn-approve:focus-visible, .ds-btn-reject:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring, oklch(85% 0.14 205)); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 3px; }

components.name: Severity Chip
components.description: The signature component. Word, glyph shape and hatch density — three independent channels, because each fails differently.
components.html: critical high medium low not determined
components.css: .ds-sev { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 8px; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 999px; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-sev::before { font-size: 0.85em; line-height: 1; margin-right: 0.25em; } .ds-sev-critical { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--sev-critical, oklch(65% 0.22 25)) 22%, transparent); color: var(--ink, oklch(96% 0.005 260)); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--sev-critical, oklch(65% 0.22 25)); background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, color-mix(in oklch, var(--sev-critical, oklch(65% 0.22 25)) 28%, transparent) 0 2px, transparent 2px 5px); } .ds-sev-critical::before { content: '\25B2\25B2'; } .ds-sev-high { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--sev-high, oklch(72% 0.18 45)) 22%, transparent); color: var(--ink, oklch(96% 0.005 260)); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--sev-high, oklch(72% 0.18 45)); background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, color-mix(in oklch, var(--sev-high, oklch(72% 0.18 45)) 28%, transparent) 0 2px, transparent 2px 7px); } .ds-sev-high::before { content: '\25B2'; } .ds-sev-medium { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--sev-medium, oklch(80% 0.15 85)) 22%, transparent); color: var(--ink, oklch(96% 0.005 260)); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--sev-medium, oklch(80% 0.15 85)); background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, color-mix(in oklch, var(--sev-medium, oklch(80% 0.15 85)) 28%, transparent) 0 2px, transparent 2px 9px); } .ds-sev-medium::before { content: '\25A0'; } .ds-sev-low { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--sev-low, oklch(75% 0.10 190)) 22%, transparent); color: var(--ink, oklch(96% 0.005 260)); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--sev-low, oklch(75% 0.10 190)); } .ds-sev-low::before { content: '\25CF'; } .ds-sev-unknown { background: var(--surface, oklch(22% 0.02 260)); color: var(--ink-muted, oklch(75% 0.02 260)); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--stroke, oklch(30% 0.01 260)); } .ds-sev-unknown::before { content: '\2014'; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: A toggle in a filter row. Pill-shaped so it reads as a token of state, not a button to press.
components.css: .ds-chip { padding: 2px 8px; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--surface, oklch(22% 0.02 260)); color: var(--ink-muted, oklch(75% 0.02 260)); border: 1px solid var(--stroke, oklch(30% 0.01 260)); cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-chip:hover { background: var(--surface-hover, oklch(26% 0.02 260)); color: var(--ink, oklch(96% 0.005 260)); } .ds-chip-active { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--brand, oklch(70% 0.16 205)) 18%, transparent); color: var(--brand, oklch(70% 0.16 205)); border-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--brand, oklch(70% 0.16 205)) 38%, transparent); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring, oklch(85% 0.14 205)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: A raised tonal step, never a shadow. Depth here is grouping, not a light source.
components.html:
Districts at risk
5
of 5 monitored
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 0.75rem 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--stroke, oklch(30% 0.01 260)); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--bg-elevated, oklch(19% 0.02 260)); } .ds-card-title { font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ink-muted, oklch(75% 0.02 260)); } .ds-card-value { font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink, oklch(96% 0.005 260)); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; line-height: 1.35; } .ds-card-meta { font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; color: var(--ink-muted, oklch(75% 0.02 260)); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Focus is drawn inside the control so a dense filter bar does not shift its layout.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.25rem; } .ds-field-label { font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ink-muted, oklch(75% 0.02 260)); } .ds-input { background: var(--bg, oklch(15% 0.02 260)); color: var(--ink, oklch(96% 0.005 260)); border: 1px solid var(--stroke-strong, oklch(40% 0.015 260)); border-radius: 3px; padding: 0.35rem 0.5rem; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; min-height: 30px; width: 100%; transition: border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--ink-faint, oklch(72% 0.02 260)); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring, oklch(85% 0.14 205)); outline-offset: -1px; border-color: var(--brand, oklch(70% 0.16 205)); }

components.name: Rail Tabs
components.description: The alert rail's tab strip. Active state is cyan text on a 2px cyan underline.
components.css: .ds-rail-tabs { display: flex; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--stroke, oklch(30% 0.01 260)); } .ds-rail-tab { flex: 1 0 auto; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.25rem; padding: 0.75rem 0.5rem; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ink-muted, oklch(75% 0.02 260)); background: transparent; border: none; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-rail-tab:hover { color: var(--ink, oklch(96% 0.005 260)); background: var(--surface-hover, oklch(26% 0.02 260)); } .ds-rail-tab-active { color: var(--brand, oklch(70% 0.16 205)); border-bottom-color: var(--brand, oklch(70% 0.16 205)); } .ds-rail-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring, oklch(85% 0.14 205)); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 3px; }

components.name: Empty / Not-Determined Note
components.description: How the platform says it does not know. Rendered as content, in the same voice as any answer — never as an error state.
components.html: Not determined — no rainfall observation for this district in the last 30 days.
components.css: .ds-empty-note { color: var(--ink-muted, oklch(75% 0.02 260)); font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; line-height: 1.6; max-width: 45ch; margin: 0; }

narrative.overview:
A room where a decision gets made and recorded. The picture is shared, so nothing is private about how a number was reached — every figure on screen carries where it came from and when. Surfaces stay calm because the content is not: this is a screen an operator reads while deciding whether to move resources, and a screen that competes for attention is a screen that loses the argument for attention when it matters.

The system is dark by decision, not by fashion, and that decision is load-bearing rather than aesthetic. A district office runs this on the laptop it does everything else on, in rooms where power is a contingency; a dark ground holds legibility when the panel is dim and does not blind the operator who has been reading it for six hours. Light and high-contrast sit beside it as first-class themes, each one measured rather than derived.

What distinguishes the system is that it treats honesty as a visual property. The states an operator most needs to read — "not ingested", "never run", "not determined" — are the ones a light treatment erases first, so --ink-faint was raised twice until it cleared 4.5:1 on the surfaces it actually lands on. Severity never rests on colour alone. Where the platform cannot compute a number it prints the reason instead, and the interface renders that reason as content rather than as an error.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first, with light and high-contrast as measured equals, not afterthoughts.
Flat at rest. Depth is tonal — a four-step ground ramp — not shadowed.
Every colour pair is verified by arithmetic in test/theme-tokens.test.js.
Severity is encoded three times over: word, glyph shape, hatch density.
Dense and quiet. This is an instrument surface, not a marketing surface.
Tabular numerals and monospace where figures must align and compare.

rules.name: The Measured-Not-Chosen Rule
rules.body: No colour enters this system by eye. Every text/surface pair is verified by test/theme-tokens.test.js, which re-runs the gate's own OKLCH→sRGB arithmetic across every combination the three themes can paint. A value that has not been through that arithmetic is a proposal.

rules.name: The One Channel Allowed to Fail Rule
rules.body: Severity colour may fail — under colour vision deficiency, in greyscale print, on a projector with no colour left. It is permitted to fail because two other channels carry the same information, and those do not.

rules.name: The No-Webfont Rule
rules.body: No font is fetched. If a surface needs a weight or width the system stack does not have, the answer is a different composition, not a different download.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Any figure appearing in a column, or compared against a neighbouring figure, uses tabular-nums. Proportional digits are for prose.

rules.name: The Shell-Is-The-Scroller Rule
rules.body: On a viewport too short for the fixed shell, the page scrolls. Content is never trapped inside a region the viewport cannot reach.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. A shadow appears only when an element genuinely leaves the page plane — it is never decoration and never a hover effect.

rules.name: The Inset-Ring Rule
rules.body: A component that changes colour on state changes only its colour. Geometry that moves when state changes is a layout bug wearing a style's clothes.

rules.name: The Three-Channel Rule
rules.body: Severity is word, glyph and hatch, on every surface, without exception — dense tables and map layers included. low takes no hatch because a texture meaning "slightly less bad" is worse than one meaning "nothing here".

rules.name: The No-Borrowed-Glyph Rule
rules.body: Sentiment chips (.chip-ok) get no severity marker. Borrowing low's ● for "positive" would put two unrelated meanings on one glyph — the exact collision the ramp exists to prevent.

rules.name: The Focus-Is-Not-Optional Rule
rules.body: Every focusable element has a visible focus state. A surface without one is not shippable, and scripts/check-a11y.mjs walks all eight surfaces in all three themes to prove it.

dos: Do verify every new colour pair with the OKLCH→sRGB arithmetic in test/theme-tokens.test.js before it ships. An unmeasured value is a proposal, not a token.
Do carry word, glyph and hatch on every severity surface, dense tables included.
Do reach for a tonal step (--bg-elevated, --surface) before a shadow.
Do give every focusable element a --focus-ring outline, drawn inside the control when it sits in a dense row.
Do use tabular-nums for any figure in a column.
Do render a refusal as content. When the platform cannot ground a number, it prints the reason — and the interface shows that reason in the same voice as any other answer, not as an error state.

Do declare a token in every theme block, including both prefers-color-scheme mirrors. A token present in one and not another resolves to nothing, and fill: var(--undefined) is invalid — which is how the map's landmass once fell back to black.
Do make each button variant standalone, so class="btn-primary" alone renders a complete control.
donts: Don't pick a colour by eye, or by what looks right on your monitor in one theme.
Don't encode severity in colour alone, on any surface, ever.
Don't add a webfont. The no-build, no-request constraint is the product's deployment model, not a preference.
Don't use a shadow as a hover effect or as decoration. Shadows are for elements that leave the page plane.
Don't reuse --ok for a cold or negative-reading data pole. It asserts a value judgement the data does not support.
Don't change a component's geometry when its state changes. Fill, ink and ring may move; box size may not.
Don't compress the shell to fit a short viewport. Release the fixed height and let the page scroll.
Don't use proportional digits in a numeric column.
Don't apply the CHW surface's 44px tap targets or 1.125rem base to the console. Density is the console's job; reach is the CHW surface's.
